title: b1bc.5: Add dkim_signer field to SmtpRelayQueue struct
description:
What: Modify SmtpRelayQueue in crates/smtp/src/relay_queue.rs to hold an optional shared DkimSigner.

Algorithm:
1. Add field: dkim_signer: Option<Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner>> to SmtpRelayQueue struct.
2. Add parameter dkim_signer: Option<Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner>> to SmtpRelayQueue::new().
3. Store it: Self { ..., dkim_signer }.
4. try_deliver_one() (and all other methods that use self) can now access self.dkim_signer — actual signing logic is in b1bc.7.
5. Update any test constructors for SmtpRelayQueue::new() to pass None.

Defensive programming:
- Arc-wrapped, not cloned — key material is read-only shared reference.
- No signing logic in this bead — just the structural change.

Tests: Existing SmtpRelayQueue tests must still compile and pass.
